# Tuya TV Viewer v0.10.0: RTP video reconstruction

Experimental Android TV build. Processes RTP only after three packets have consistent sequence numbers and SSRC; reconstructs H.264 FU-A and HEVC FU fragments. Diagnostics report candidate and verified RTP, reconstructed NAL units, and candidate SPS/PPS/IDR, without video or user data in logs. Java and Python tests passed. Video reception and display were not yet verified on LSC cameras. No validated fix was available for the newer SDP timeout action. Android 7+ / arm64; app name and application ID unchanged from v0.9. A debug-signed GitHub Actions APK may require uninstalling the previous build.
